newsitem.title: USA: Fed's FOMC resumes meeting, no rate rise expected.
newsitem.headline: Fed's FOMC resumes meeting, no rate rise expected.

text.p: The Federal Reserve resumed its two-day policy-making meeting on Wednesday, a central bank spokeswoman said.
The meeting resumed as scheduled at 9:00 a.m. EST 1400 GMT.
The central bank's Federal Open Market Committee is expected to announce its decision on interest rates at about 2:15 p.m. 1915 GMT.
Analysts say no rate change is expected.
